rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Relief Is Suspicious
card.instruction: Treat every reassuring development as evidence that the real threat has merely changed shape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our restaurant passed inspection? Even the grease trap?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Spotless. I had it pumped out. Can I start cooking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So the trouble's moved into the tanker. Is it still outside?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's sealed. Nothing can escape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've bottled it under pressure beside our diners. Ask the driver to leave before I unlock the doors.

card.title: Relief Is Suspicious
card.instruction: Treat every reassuring development as evidence that the real threat has merely changed shape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The neighbours liked my speech? I thought they'd vote me off the committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've asked you to chair next month's meeting. Please say yes; I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So they're keeping me where they can watch me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you and handle complaints.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've given me a minder. Will you be reporting my mistakes to them?

card.title: Rescue Me by Needing Me
card.instruction: Take protective control, then let each consequence reveal how much your confidence depends on remaining necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me fix your bike before you ride. I know which bolts matter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've tightened them already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check the checking. There must be something left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can just come riding with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Without a repair to do? Give me a minute to remember how.

card.title: Rescue Me by Needing Me
card.instruction: Take protective control, then let each consequence reveal how much your confidence depends on remaining necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me your landlord's number. I'll get your deposit back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Already done, Mum. I'm taking you out to celebrate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me book. You still need someone who checks the reviews.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked your favourite. Just bring yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not even a cake? Could you forget your reading glasses? I could read you the menu.

card.title: Belonging on Changing Terms
card.instruction: Seek acceptance by adapting quickly, then let each adaptation create a new version of yourself you must defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I bought this jacket for my first supper at your sailing club. Will I fit in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're casual. Roll your sleeves up; I'll introduce you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There. I'm one of those relaxed old hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lovely. I'll tell them you're new so they'll explain things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say I'm returning. You can explain the boats privately. These sleeves suggest I already know.

card.title: Belonging on Changing Terms
card.instruction: Seek acceptance by adapting quickly, then let each adaptation create a new version of yourself you must defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You wanted a more adventurous friend, so I've booked us climbing lessons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant trying a new cafe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Well, I'm a climbing person now. I've told my sister.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cancel. I need a friend who listens.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'm a listener. Will you tell my sister I listened to you, rather than gave up climbing?

card.title: Humility with Evidence
card.instruction: Perform modesty while planting small facts that can later assemble themselves into undeniable proof of your importance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the hall minutes, just say the roof's repaired. My six weekends aren't worth recording.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good. I'm keeping the minutes to one page.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: These dated invoices can go separately. My initials only show who paid.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put them in the accounts folder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. A tiny footnote will do: accounts, pages one to forty. No need to name me twice.

card.title: Humility with Evidence
card.instruction: Perform modesty while planting small facts that can later assemble themselves into undeniable proof of your importance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Anyone could have organised the concert. My thirty-seven calls were hardly heroic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thirty-seven?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only the completed ones. I wouldn't inflate the figure with attempts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want a thank-you speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, no. Just make sure whoever writes it has the call log.

card.title: The Ritual Explains Itself Later
card.instruction: Treat one unexplained recurring action as essential. Allow its meaning to change each time it returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait, don't drink yet. Two taps on the cup first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: For luck? That's good tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two taps meant Mum had made it weak. We'd better tap again; she'll think we've gone polite.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I miss her complaints. The table's too quiet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two more, then. These are to leave her a turn. We can wait before we drink.

card.title: The Ritual Explains Itself Later
card.instruction: Treat one unexplained recurring action as essential. Allow its meaning to change each time it returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before rehearsal, lift this chair and set it down. We can't skip it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That squeak stopped everyone talking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lift it and set it down again. The back row needs to hear we're starting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now they're staring at the new singer. She's the only one standing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lift it and set it down beside mine. She needs a welcome before we need a note.

card.title: The Warning Was Already Here
card.instruction: Choose one early detail as the warning sign, then let every later development reveal a larger version of the same disaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That little crack beside the piano was the stage warning us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The piano's leaning. Help me move it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The crack's opened a place for the whole piano. Keep your end away from it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The front row's tilting too. I'm clearing the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's reached the audience. That little crack is taking the whole concert downstairs. I'll get the balcony.

card.title: The Warning Was Already Here
card.instruction: Choose one early detail as the warning sign, then let every later development reveal a larger version of the same disaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They misspelled our wedding invitation. That was the warning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now the cake names another couple. Help me scrape it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same mistake, larger icing budget. Pass me a knife.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That couple's here. I've offered them half our reception room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The typo's taking half our wedding. Before you offer them my chair, check which name's on it.

card.title: Track the Cost That Returns
card.instruction: Accept every twist, but keep returning to one practical consequence whose importance grows as the scene becomes more complicated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our garden fountain grants wishes. Fine. We're still paying for its water.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wished for ten more. We can sell admission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Eleven fountains on our meter. Charge enough to cover that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Visitors wished for fountains at home. They're all fed from ours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we're paying to water the whole queue's gardens. Sell them monthly passes before the next bill arrives.

card.title: Track the Cost That Returns
card.instruction: Accept every twist, but keep returning to one practical consequence whose importance grows as the scene becomes more complicated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, our house travels through time. Can we stop somewhere that fixes roof tiles?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ancient Rome. I'll find a roofer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Get a quote. The bucket's already half full.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I touched the dial. We're underwater now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. That same leak is admitting the sea. Reverse us while I empty the bucket into the sink.

transfer.action: I inspect the reassuring note beside {prop} for a hidden second page.
transfer.opening: Too good. The bad part has learned manners. {request}
transfer.response: An all-clear gives danger somewhere new to hide. {counter}
transfer.closing: After explaining why it arrived dressed so carefully as reassurance.

transfer.action: I keep a hand on the difficult task beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I'd be steadier if you still needed this part of me. {request}
transfer.response: Leave me one corner of the rescue to handle. {counter}
transfer.closing: I know. That's the part I'm finding hardest to keep safe from.

transfer.action: I change my badge beside {prop} to match the newest welcome.
transfer.opening: This is the version of me you invited, right? {request}
transfer.response: I can't change again; I've just become this person. {counter}
transfer.closing: Which one gets to stay when the welcome changes again?

transfer.action: I tuck my initials and dated effort log beneath {prop}.
transfer.opening: Nothing special. My six calls just happen to be listed. {request}
transfer.response: It practically solved itself, after these little dates. {counter}
transfer.closing: Only for accurate reading of the conveniently available evidence.

transfer.action: I tap twice beside {prop}, leaving a pause for a missing third tap.
transfer.opening: First it was luck. Today it's how I remember. {request}
transfer.response: Same gesture. Different reason for needing it. {counter}
transfer.closing: I'm leaving room for someone who used to answer the third tap.

transfer.action: I put the earliest warning sketch beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: We called that crack decoration at the beginning. {request}
transfer.challenge: We need to fix today's damage.
transfer.closing: Start where yesterday tried to make itself noticed quietly.

transfer.action: I bring the original overflowing bucket beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Every new twist still drips in here. {request}
transfer.response: We're still paying for the first loose screw. {counter}
transfer.closing: Does it empty the bucket or only give us another thing to announce above it?
